text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Glory be, glory to the warriors! Glory 
be, glory to meee!"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Today's speech feels even more 
exhilarating. I simply must share this 
with someone...!"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
La-la-la~~♪ Isn't that right~~, 
Ayabe-sa~~~n♪

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...Move. You're getting in the way of my 
training.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Ayabe-san... by that, you mean— You want 
to run side by side right next to me, not 
in front of me! That's what you mean, 
right?!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Why did it turn out like that...!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Leave me alone...!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Alright, if I can just run away this 
far...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Boi~ng!)

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, I'm so sorry! It's my fault for 
spacing out like that~!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Doto... looks like you aren't hurt. Well 
then, I'm in a hurry, so...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Huh? Something feels off with my legs...?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Huh...? My shoelaces are tangled...!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Hyowaaaa~~~?! Seriously, why! I'm so, so 
sorryyyy!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Ayabe-saaan! Where are youuu!? Shall we 
not aim for La Scala in Milan together?!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Ngh, it's getting closer!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Okay, I'll untangle it right away...! Um, 
this goes... here... Huh? Wait!?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Fuee~! It's even more of a mess now...! 
Wh-Wh-Wh-Whyyy~~~!?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"...There's no time. You're running away 
with me...!"

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Right, left, right, left! Come on, we're 
picking up the pace!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
H-Hahaha, yes, ma'am! One-two, 
one-twoooo~?!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
You two are just like Carlo and Rodrigo! 
Ah, and with me joining the stage... a 
brand new tale is about to unfold!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The three of them ran all over the place, 
getting in even more exercise than they 
usually do in training...
